description: Story Phase 4 (Life Around the Dead Center) has begun: the first proper morning of the new normal.
Garrick wears the Grand Stenchmaster sash he made for himself (a permanent part of his regalia).
Stinkbeard attended the morning Frog Grog ration in the galley.
Squawks refused his Frog Grog. The wisest decision of the morning.
The crew know every beard remedy the captain has tried. None worked (molecular beard level).
Stinkbeard asked the most important question aboard: where is the Dead Center today?
Garrick produced the first Grand Stenchmaster Stench Forecast, in crayon.
Stinkbeard studied the first forecast (Bad Here, Probably).
'That might be now.' The Dead Center rolled into the breakfast area.
Stinkbeard got Squawks and himself out of the galley ahead of the Center.
Garrick's obsolete forecast landed in the captain's Frog Grog. 'Now it's fortified.'
Garrick has put up the Forecast Board at the Grand Stenchmaster's station.
Stinkbeard has looked at the Forecast Board (the forecast system).
Chapter 16: the crew reorganise their days around the Dead Center (day 2).
Squawks has three new feathers (the yellow one and two more).
The bell protocol exists: one to four coughing bells.
Stinkbeard has read the bell protocol notice by the ship's bell.
The Dead Center moved into the washroom with Gristle inside.
Stinkbeard found the air scuttle on deck above the washroom.
Gristle was hauled out of the washroom through the air scuttle.
The Dead Center settled on Salty Jim's stove with the stew on it.
Stinkbeard smothered the galley stove by closing the stovepipe damper on deck.
Lunch was salvaged from the biscuit crate in the cargo hold.
Lunch survived the galley blockade (as biscuits).
The Dead Center took over the sleeping quarters for the night.
The crew bedded down on deck instead.
Pete showed everyone his yellow pillow. Bob nearly smelled it.
Three bells at three in the morning: the Center crossed the deck camp.
Stinkbeard got Squawks first, as always.
Pete saved the Frog Grog by mistake and threw it overboard. The sharks thrashed.
Garrick evacuated pillows, a frying pan and his coins (Grand Stenchmaster priorities).
The 3 AM deck evacuation is over.
The Dead Center sat on the quarterdeck; nobody could reach the helm.
Stinkbeard asked what an 'atmospheric sausage' is (advanced science).
The Revenge was brought back on course once the Center moved.
Chapter 17: the Center keeps choosing exactly the room that is needed.
Powder room, medicine chest, oven, washroom: the Center's worst choices.
Stinkbeard attempted one more serious beard wash.
The Center passed through mid-wash. The beard has been REFRESHED (more years added).
Stinkbeard read the Stench Log's note on his beard and did not approve the wording.
Squawks grew seven new feathers in all (the yellow one included).
Three bells during the feather celebration: SAVE FEATHERS!
Stinkbeard carried Squawks out under his coat.
They went back into the cabin after the cloud cleared.
All seven feathers fell out, one by one and then all at once. Bald again.
Garrick called it a 'recurring molt'. Squawks called it 'Fart hates feathers.'
Chapter 18: Shark Duty, the most hated job on the ship.
Jory explained Shark Duty: poles, paddles, mops, and discouragement.
Stinkbeard took a pole and reported to the port rail.
Stinkbeard pointed out that piracy was supposed to involve merchant ships.
Jory reported the port damage (patches on patches).
Twenty sharks to port, thirty to starboard.
'HOW MANY?' 'HUNDREDS.'
The Grand Stenchmaster was eating garlic toast during the emergency.
Garrick refused Shark Duty: shark management is outside his office.
Three bells on Shark Duty: the Center rolled toward the hull they were defending.
Everyone abandoned Shark Duty ahead of the Center.
The Dead Center reached the waterline. The ocean erupted: Shark Frenzy.
'Ship smaller.' Squawks was right.
'It has not ended YET.' 'IT IS ACTIVELY ENDING.'
Garrick documented the waterline disaster in the Stench Log. 'Excellent response.'
Chapter 19: the Center moves off and the crew repair everything.
'REPAIR EVERYTHING.' The repairs are under way.
Supervisors do not hammer. The Grand Stenchmaster outranks supervisor. Nobody agrees.
The worst forecast yet: six skulls, a crowned shark and Stinkbeard House.
Garrick turned the map upside down, sniffed, and said it: THE CENTER IS COMING BACK.
Everyone evacuated from the fresh repair.
The fresh repair lasted seconds. They are repairing slower than the sharks are eating.
Garrick drank the forecast out of the captain's grog, paper and all. 'Waste not.'
Roughly another three hundred sharks.
The sharks follow the yellow wake. The ship has been advertising.
Tomorrow: VERY BAD. 70%. 700%. 'That seems more accurate.'
Story Phase 4 (Life Around the Dead Center) is complete.
Stinkbeard heard Gristle (and Garrick, through the wall) at the washroom door.
The crew scrambled aft from the deck camp at three in the morning.
A new board is in the gap in the port rail.
The chewed stanchion is braced with rope.
The weak section above the waterline is patched.
The captain has taken an optional Shark Duty shift (after Phase 4).
